name: Sam Altman
summary: Founder and investor with experience scaling startups and leading frontier AI research organisations. Strong in fundraising, hiring and turning research breakthroughs into products used by millions.

children: Leading the development of GPT-4 and other state-of-the-art large language models.
Orchestrating massive-scale compute and data strategies for foundational AI research.
Managing strategic partnerships with major technology and cloud providers.
Directing the deployment of conversational AI to hundreds of millions of users globally.
Implementing industry-leading AI safety and alignment protocols.
Advocating for global governance frameworks for artificial general intelligence.
Bridging the gap between cutting-edge research and real-world commercial applications.
Oversaw organizational scaling during OpenAI's transition from a research lab to a major AI player.
Managed strategic initiatives to build the foundation for large-scale AI research.
Collaborated on mission-critical funding and partnership efforts.
Guided hundreds of early-stage startups through the YC growth engine.
Developed frameworks for scalable startup growth and product-market fit.
Built a global network of founders and investors.

projects.title: ChatGPT
projects.subtitle: Conversational AI Revolution
bullets: Orchestrated the global launch of the world's first massive-scale conversational AI interface.
Transformed human-computer interaction through natural language processing.
Managed the massive-scale inference infrastructure required for real-time global access.
Led the product iteration cycle that defined the modern LLM user experience.

projects.title: OpenAI API
projects.subtitle: Developer Ecosystem
bullets: Pioneered the model-as-a-service paradigm, enabling thousands of developers to build on GPT.
Built the technical and commercial infrastructure for the global AI developer community.
Established the standard for API-driven generative AI applications.

activities.title: AI Safety Advocacy

bullets: Testifying before government bodies on the importance of AI regulation and safety.
Collaborating with international research organizations on alignment research.
Promoting the responsible development and deployment of autonomous agents.
